headline: OKJ price surge on extreme volume spike coincides with company's SET clarification filing, leading the morning watchlist.
market_take: Coverage picture is dominated by micro-cap and low-priced names with 50% intraday moves (TRITN, KC) on very thin volume, alongside several high-conviction volume and price alerts. PF&REIT and FOOD are the most active sectors; CONMAT shows two notable gap-and-recover cases in GEL. Multiple mid-cap names (TKN, ITD, LH, STPI) have relevant corporate actions, so the day pairs tape-monitoring with disclosure follow-up.

sector_notes.note: OKJ (+15.88%, 129.8σ volume) and RBF (+5.11%) lead, with OKJ backed by a 2026-10-05 SET clarification filing. CPF flagged a 14.6σ volume spike; XBIO and BR also triggered alerts. TKN continues to file share-repurchase forms.
GEL opened -20.00% then rallied +25.00% intraday for a +25.0% 5d move, a clear gap-and-recover. DCON opened +6.25% on a shareholders-rights progress filing.
SPRIME triggered a 6.9σ volume spike. CTARAF filed a paid-up capital decrease; ALLY notified offering price and non-Thai nationality list; KTBSTMR had a REIT manager personnel change.

PF (-20.00%) accompanies two debentureholders' meeting filings on 2026-10-02. EVER (-14.29%) and SAMCO (-5.00%, 4.3σ volume) are the other active names; LH declared an interim dividend and LPN filed a board resolution.
TRITN +50.00% and PLE +20.00% (2.36x vol) lead; PLE opened with a +20.00% gap. TPOLY -10.00% and SQ -5.56% on the downside. TTCL +33.3% over 5d follows a rehabilitation progress filing on 2026-10-05.
TL filed a SET-clarified Q2/2026 financial-statement response (high impact); SMO announced the resignation of its Chairman and Risk Management Committee chair.
